summary: The draft terms are replaced by the full Terms and Conditions of Alexander Beeken d/b/a Skrongle.
They cover paid plans (billed monthly in Canadian dollars, cancel any time), what you may and may not post, and AI-generated courses.
Disputes go to arbitration in Vancouver under the laws of Canada.
From now on we tell you what changed when the terms change, and e-mail you 30 days ahead of a change that affects your rights or a paid plan.
The privacy policy changed: the draft at /privacy is replaced by the full privacy notice.

It says what we collect (your account, learning data, courses and notes, payment status, server logs), who else sees it (hosting, Stripe, the e-mail and text providers, the AI providers you use, the content check), how long we keep it (nothing longer than a month after your account is gone) and how to download or delete your data.
New contact addresses: one for help with the site, plans and payments, and one for privacy requests, copyright notices and other legal matters. Section 32 lists both.
The privacy policy changed: sign-in with Google is gone, so the notice no longer describes social logins or Google's API policy, and no longer lists Google as an authentication service.
